General almost-abelian Lie-automorphism structure is prior art; the asserted new work is finite-field unit-cocycle enumeration, fixed-space polynomial, and arithmetic threshold.
Priority risk remains from potentially equivalent older finite-field cyclic semilinear and Lie-automorphism enumerations.
An independent mathematical audit has not been conducted.
title: Full fixed-space spectrum and field-order rigidity for standard filiform Lie automorphisms
